title: 鳥類学的遺言書に関する考察：1924年鴉鳴島失踪事件の再構成
author: 学者 ヘルマン

en.title: A Study of an Ornithological Will: Reconstruction of the 1924 Karamejima Disappearance Incident
en.premise: The will left by a renowned ornithologist consisted of nothing but an inexplicable "migratory bird arrival schedule" and a set of "coordinates." Following the will, relatives gathered on the island, only to vanish one by one in physically impossible locked-room scenarios, synchronized with the arrival of the birds. Using fragmentary diaries and autopsy reports, the chronicler seeks to unravel the logic of murder hidden within this "bird map."

zh.title: 关于鸟类学遗嘱的研究：1924年鸦鸣岛失踪事件的重构
zh.premise: 一位著名的鸟类学家留下的遗嘱，仅由难以理解的“候鸟迁徙时间表”和“坐标”组成。遵循遗嘱来到岛上的亲属们，随着候鸟的到来，竟在物理上不可能实现的密室状态下接连失踪。记录者通过留下的碎片化日记与尸检报告，试图揭开隐藏在这张“鸟类地图”背后的杀人逻辑。
